## **Equipment and Ships**
## **Weapons**
Dark elves use high quality weapons designed to inflict malicious, painful wounds. Most dark elf weapons are covered by the rules in the **WFRP Core Rulebook** , but some exceptions are detailed here. 

*All weapons in this chapter are available to buy on _Temple of Spite,_ but only for those who appear to be dark elves. Prices are given in gold crowns, as traders on board will take them and change to the ark’s ‘silver moons’ currency (8 GC = 1 silver moon).

**Sword.** Dark elf swords are fashioned with the distinctive barbed style of Naggaroth. Nobles traditionally wear two swords as a mark of rank, many favouring _vraith_ : sleek blades intended for dual-wielding. 

**Draich.** The _draich_ is a class of heavy two-handed blade wielded by Khaine’s anointed executioners. They may be an axe or vicious sword, treat as a Greataxe or Zweihänder. 

**Spear.** A Naggarothi spear is a _drannach_ or ‘sky piercer’, a long, heavy-bladed weapon. 

**Spineblade.** A _ghlaith_ is a short, archaic weapon with a hooked blade used for duelling, rarely used in recent centuries. The name means ‘spineblade’, properly used for paralysing blows to the lower back or limbs. 

**Soultaker.** A _lakelui_ is a long, barbed blade used to dispatch enemies in a duel. 

**Vambrace blades.** Dark elves may wear fitted vambraces bearing razor sharp blades, used in combat to slash at an opponent’s flesh. 

**Repeater Crossbow** . Before the Sundering, the dwarfs supplied Malerion’s armies with the first repeater crossbows, which eventually replaced traditional elven bows. What they lose in range and power, they make up for in rate of fire. They are called _uraithen_ , meaning ‘death rain’. 

**Repeater Handbow.** A smaller version of the repeater crossbow, favoured by corsairs. Similar to a crossbow pistol, though able to fire 3 shots before reloading. Often carried in a brace of two, to unleash a rapid flurry of bolts at an enemy. 

**Reaper Bolt Thrower.** Reapers are ballistae deployed on dark elf ships, fortifications, and on the battlefield. They can fire a hail of shots or a single missile with considerable force. Bolts are barbed to inflict horrific injuries. 

**Sky Reaper** . A smaller reaper bolt thrower adapted to fire at aerial targets. Usually mounted on towers as defence against high elf dragons, great eagles, and griffons. 

**Ravager Harpoon** . Beastmasters’ scourgerunner chariots are armed with a light bolt thrower, which fires barbed harpoons on chains. 

**Net.** Dark elf beastmasters and gladiators use nets to goad and entangle their opponents. **Note:** unlike the Weighted Net in **Up In Arms** , this is wielded one-handed.
